notes.title: UPDATED DEMO!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44652110/bea9f646a83a39eada880209e282a35cede25985.png"][/img][/p][p]Updated tha demoooooo[/p][olist][*][p]Added Gyro controller support and a gyro options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few unlockable player skinz so the money does something lmao[/p][/*][*][p]Added  some wallpapers u can find for the in game desktop[/p][/*][*][p]did a buncha various fixes and small additions to the game since last we met[/p][/*][*][p]put in some birds[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank u for all the support as I continue finishing this evil videogame. I am hoping to get the game out this year, but it's gonna take a lot of work to get it to that point. Hopefully I can pull it off. In the meantime, I hope u enjoy the demo.[/p]
